reviewed_by: Claude: bound selected pytest runs in CI and keep a stack for hangs
reason: The selected python job runs pytest through scripts/run_pytest_thread_guard.py, which had no overall time bound and only stopped pytest after a reported thread leak; the job had no timeout-minutes and no faulthandler timeout. On 2026-11-23 the Python 3.12 job hung four times in its Test step (20-80 min) on PRs #1303/#1304 while the same selections passed locally on 3.11 and 3.12 in 1-2.5 min; cancelled jobs keep no logs, so the hanging test was never identified. The runner gains --max-seconds (stops pytest's owned process group, exit 1), CI passes --max-seconds 1200 and -o faulthandler_timeout=180 so a hung test dumps every thread's stack before the bound, and the job gets timeout-minutes: 45 as a backstop. Select the thread leak guard tests, including a new one that hangs a synthetic test and asserts the bound and the dumped stack.
exclusions: No product code change; frontend, Playwright and native layers are empty. The full-source job's guard invocation is unchanged. No full-suite approval.
